doNotInfer: Do NOT edit any file under apps/demo/src/components/. This is a token-layer-only diff; if a consumer looks like it needs changing, that is #1913 or #1914's job — stop and report rather than reaching across.
Do NOT rename --juli-run-live-edge. The name carries the 'reserved for the live edge only' rule, and redefining a ground and an accent with zero consumer edits is the proof the architecture works.
Do NOT retain the dark values behind a selector or a media query. ADR-102 decision 5: what makes a future re-theme cheap is the layer shape, not an unused mode nothing tests.

Do NOT declare a blur token without consuming it. Every --juli-run-*-blur is read by a backdrop-filter in this same file at 0px, because a glass pass that must ADD a property to every panel rule is a consumer change.
Do NOT write an rgba() literal. Every derived value is color-mix(in srgb, ...) so tints track their base.
Do NOT adjust the existing contrast ratios in the file docstring. They measure grounds that no longer exist — delete and re-derive against the new layer fills.
Do NOT touch packages/theme/tokens.css. Its byte-identity is asserted and is the #1314 criterion that still holds.
Do NOT weaken the scoping contract: every property stays under [data-juli-surface="run"], never :root, and this file never writes an app-wide --juli-* name.
